newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Roche sees dilution on deal "significant".
newsitem.headline: Roche sees dilution on deal "significant".

text.p: Roche Holding AG said it expected dilution of earnings from a deal announced earlier Monday to take over Boehringer Mannheim as likely to be significant in the first year, once it is approved.
Company Finance Officer Henri Meier, speaking at a news briefing, said there would be "a quite significant dilution".
He added, reiterating earlier comments, that this would result from the costs of the transaction, and loss of earnings from high-yielding liquid investments.
"And it will take some time until we are back at the same level of profitability," he said.
At the current time it did not appear that a dilution was likely in the second year.
But it would only be possible to say exactly how the impact would be felt once a due diligence study is completed in the months ahead, he said. -- Zurich Editorial, +41 1 631 7340
